purpose: Navigable research worksheet, not numeric outlet ranking.

dimensions.label: Operator and ownership
questions: Who legally operates the publication?
Is beneficial ownership actually documented?
What dates and records support the relationship?

dimensions.label: Funding
questions: Which revenue categories or grants are disclosed?
What accounting period and denominator support a share?
Are partner, donor and owner roles kept distinct?

dimensions.label: Editorial remit
questions: What purpose and audience does the source state?
Is the statement attributed rather than certified?

dimensions.label: Sourcing and support
questions: What precise claim is being made?
Is the support observation, statement, document, image, inference or secondhand report?
Where are the source and stable locator?

dimensions.label: Source dependence
questions: Do reports share an original wire, statement or translation?
Which evidence lineages are genuinely separate?

dimensions.label: Framing
questions: Which actor/action/consequence leads?
How are agency, labels, context and uncertainty expressed?
Are compared items similar genres and publication stages?

dimensions.label: Unaddressed questions
questions: Which relevant question is absent from this selected report?
Was the information available at publication time?
Is absence bounded to the sample rather than attributed intent?

dimensions.label: Changes and corrections
questions: Is a policy linked?
Was an actual correction or update observed?
Are earlier and later versions preserved as separate records?

dimensions.label: Rights and access
questions: Who owns the original material?
What permission or licence supports collection/reuse?
Is metadata sufficient?

claim_assessment_rule: Every assessment needs a scoped rationale and evidence; it is not an outlet score or probability.
institutional_edge_rule: Documented legal/institutional relationships belong in a distinct layer; no control edge from shared donors, geography, language or identity.
